en.text: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧妇人建立家室； 愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧婦人建立家室； 愚妄婦人親手拆毀。

en.text: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

zhSimplified.text: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华； 行事乖僻的，却藐视他。

zhTraditional.text: 行動正直的，敬畏耶和華； 行事乖僻的，卻藐視他。

en.text: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

zhSimplified.text: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身； 智慧人的嘴必保守自己。

zhTraditional.text: 愚妄人口中驕傲，如杖責打己身； 智慧人的嘴必保守自己。

en.text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

zhSimplified.text: 家里无牛，槽头干净； 土产加多乃凭牛力。

zhTraditional.text: 家裏無牛，槽頭乾淨； 土產加多乃憑牛力。

en.text: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

zhSimplified.text: 诚实见证人不说谎话； 假见证人吐出谎言。

zhTraditional.text: 誠實見證人不說謊話； 假見證人吐出謊言。

en.text: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

zhSimplified.text: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不着； 聪明人易得知识。

zhTraditional.text: 褻慢人尋智慧，卻尋不着； 聰明人易得知識。

en.text: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

zhSimplified.text: 到愚昧人面前， 不见他嘴中有知识。

zhTraditional.text: 到愚昧人面前， 不見他嘴中有知識。

en.text: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

zhSimplified.text: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道； 愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈。

zhTraditional.text: 通達人的智慧在乎明白己道； 愚昧人的愚妄乃是詭詐。

en.text: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

zhSimplified.text: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍； 正直人互相喜悦。

footnotes.text: - 14:9 或译：赎愆祭愚弄愚妄人

zhTraditional.text: 愚妄人犯罪，以為戲耍； 正直人互相喜悅。

footnotes.text: - 14:9 或譯：贖愆祭愚弄愚妄人

en.text: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

zhSimplified.text: 心中的苦楚，自己知道； 心里的喜乐，外人无干。

zhTraditional.text: 心中的苦楚，自己知道； 心裏的喜樂，外人無干。

en.text: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

zhSimplified.text: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒； 正直人的帐棚必兴盛。

zhTraditional.text: 奸惡人的房屋必傾倒； 正直人的帳棚必興盛。

en.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

zhSimplified.text: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。

zhTraditional.text: 有一條路，人以為正， 至終成為死亡之路。

en.text: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

zhSimplified.text: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁； 快乐至极就生愁苦。

zhTraditional.text: 人在喜笑中，心也憂愁； 快樂至極就生愁苦。

en.text: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果； 善人必从自己的行为得以知足。

zhTraditional.text: 心中背道的，必滿得自己的結果； 善人必從自己的行為得以知足。

en.text: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 愚蒙人是话都信； 通达人步步谨慎。

zhTraditional.text: 愚蒙人是話都信； 通達人步步謹慎。

en.text: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事； 愚妄人却狂傲自恃。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人懼怕，就遠離惡事； 愚妄人卻狂傲自恃。

en.text: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

zhSimplified.text: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄； 设立诡计的，被人恨恶。

zhTraditional.text: 輕易發怒的，行事愚妄； 設立詭計的，被人恨惡。

en.text: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业； 通达人得知识为冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 愚蒙人得愚昧為產業； 通達人得知識為冠冕。

en.text: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 坏人俯伏在善人面前； 恶人俯伏在义人门口。

zhTraditional.text: 壞人俯伏在善人面前； 惡人俯伏在義人門口。

en.text: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

zhSimplified.text: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他； 富足人朋友最多。

zhTraditional.text: 貧窮人連鄰舍也恨他； 富足人朋友最多。

en.text: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪； 怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。

zhTraditional.text: 藐視鄰舍的，這人有罪； 憐憫貧窮的，這人有福。

en.text: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

zhSimplified.text: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途吗？ 谋善的，必得慈爱和诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 謀惡的，豈非走入迷途嗎？ 謀善的，必得慈愛和誠實。

en.text: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

zhSimplified.text: 诸般勤劳都有益处； 嘴上多言乃致穷乏。

zhTraditional.text: 諸般勤勞都有益處； 嘴上多言乃致窮乏。

en.text: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕； 愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人的財為自己的冠冕； 愚妄人的愚昧終是愚昧。

en.text: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

zhSimplified.text: 作真见证的，救人性命； 吐出谎言的，施行诡诈。

zhTraditional.text: 作真見證的，救人性命； 吐出謊言的，施行詭詐。

en.text: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠； 他的儿女也有避难所。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華的，大有倚靠； 他的兒女也有避難所。

en.text: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華就是生命的泉源， 可以使人離開死亡的網羅。

en.text: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

zhSimplified.text: 帝王荣耀在乎民多； 君王衰败在乎民少。

zhTraditional.text: 帝王榮耀在乎民多； 君王衰敗在乎民少。

en.text: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

zhSimplified.text: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明； 性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。

zhTraditional.text: 不輕易發怒的，大有聰明； 性情暴躁的，大顯愚妄。

en.text: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

zhSimplified.text: 心中安静是肉体的生命； 嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。

zhTraditional.text: 心中安靜是肉體的生命； 嫉妒是骨中的朽爛。

en.text: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

zhSimplified.text: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主； 怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。

zhTraditional.text: 欺壓貧寒的，是辱沒造他的主； 憐憫窮乏的，乃是尊敬主。

en.text: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒； 义人临死，有所投靠。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人在所行的惡上必被推倒； 義人臨死，有所投靠。

en.text: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧存在聪明人心中； 愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧存在聰明人心中； 愚昧人心裏所存的，顯而易見。

en.text: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

zhSimplified.text: 公义使邦国高举； 罪恶是人民的羞辱。

zhTraditional.text: 公義使邦國高舉； 罪惡是人民的羞辱。

en.text: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠； 贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠； 貽羞的僕人遭其震怒。
